commands.frame_selection: Pass --frame N repeatedly to render only those frames. An omitted selection renders the inclusive job timeline.

context.policy_sha256: Lowercase SHA-256 pin supplied by the caller.
context.toolchain_sha256: Lowercase SHA-256 pin supplied by the caller.
context.timeout_s: Positive integer. The build checks elapsed wall time before profiles, cues, frames and publication. The caller enforces a hard process deadline.

body.locale: Language tag metadata, such as fr-FR. It is recorded in native receipts. The caller supplies localized text and compatible fonts.
body.fonts: Nonempty map of alias to {path, sha256}. Relative paths resolve from the job file. The exact bytes of every declared font are checked before build. Each used font is packed in the editable scene.
body.frame_end: Last frame, inclusive. Convert a half-open end by subtracting one frame before submitting.
body.safe_area: Normalized [left, top, right, bottom] with top-left origin. Every cue box and visible layer must fit.
body.profiles: Nonempty array of {id, width, height}. IDs are unique and dimensions are integer pixels.
body.cues: Nonempty ordered array. Later entries paint above earlier entries.

cue_required.id: Unique identifier. Cue IDs, profile IDs and font aliases use ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens and begin with a letter or digit.
cue_required.text: Printable Unicode. Authored newlines are kept. Greedy whitespace wrapping uses the selected font. A single overwide token or a block taller than its box is rejected.
cue_required.box: Normalized [left, top, right, bottom] inside safe_area.
cue_required.size: Blender font size as a fraction of frame height.
cue_required.color: sRGB RGBA, with positive glyph alpha.

cue_optional.font: Alias in fonts. Omit to use default_font.
cue_optional.background: sRGB RGBA backing behind the text. Omit or use zero alpha for glyphs alone.
cue_optional.padding: Backing padding as a fraction of frame height. Defaults to zero.
cue_optional.fade_in: Nonnegative integer f. Opacity is zero at start-1, alpha/(f+1) at start, and full at start+f.
cue_optional.fade_out: Nonnegative integer f. Opacity is full at end-f, alpha/(f+1) at end, and zero at end+1. The sum of the fade lengths must be at most end-start.

outputs.build: Atomically publishes receipt.json and {profile}/source.blend, {profile}/receipt.json, and {profile}/plates/*.png under the output directory.
outputs.receipt: The af.text/v1 receipt records exact request bytes, caller context and relative native receipt paths with SHA-256. The text-slot/receipt-v1 receipts record actual font pins, locale, editable cue text and size, source and per-frame plate digests.
outputs.source: Editable Blender FONT objects, keyframes, markers and packed fonts. Text or size changes are recorded in the native receipt. Rebuild from the job to reflow edits and refit backing meshes.
outputs.render: Reopens a packed scene, checks font bytes and safe-area geometry, and publishes the native receipt and RGBA plates.
outputs.legacy: A bare text-slot/job-v1 remains supported with its single font and transparent fade endpoints. Existing text-slot/job-v1 scenes reopen with the original receipt fields.
